subject: website
name: Nook
summary: The Nook product page, a hand-written site whose script is readable and has no dependencies, served as written, so its source is public (no licence file for the page; the app it advertises is BSD-3-Clause). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it asks api.github.com for the latest release notes.

connections.name: GitHub API (api.github.com)
connections.note: Latest release read when the page opens.
